MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable felt useful because it could connect my video equipment to my 4K TV, with extra length for placement.",
    "The third-generation Echo Dot felt like a useful addition because hands-free Alexa access could complement my existing Fire TV devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD and previous-generation Fire TV sticks repeat a function already covered by my 4K stick and Fire TV television, without a clear added benefit.",
    "The earbuds, portable speaker, and older tablet do not address my current home viewing or security needs.",
    "The memory cards could be relevant to recording, but I would need to confirm camera compatibility and recording-speed requirements before choosing either."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My use of Fire TV seems to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, even when their purpose overlaps with equipment I already own.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in audio, tablets, and storage, although I choose equipment for specific tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My existing 4K equipment matters: another streaming device needs to add a capability I do not already have.",
    "A useful next purchase would help connect or control my home setup, rather than simply resemble something I bought before.",
    "Camera accessories need to match the requirements of my particular equipment; storage capacity alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my connected home setup, but missed that I want compatible additions with a clear purpose rather than duplicate devices or unrelated electronics."
}
